summary: Iteration 324 - Vision Enrich Competitors Backend Tests. All 9 tests PASSED (100%). Tested POST /api/revenue/market-robot/{property_id}/competitors/vision-enrich, GET /competitors/vision-status, POST /competitors/bulk-add with vision_* fields, and auth enforcement.

critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/revenue/market-robot/{property_id}/competitors/vision-status returns status doc with {status, total, done, enriched, blocked, errors, started_at, finished_at}
Initially returns {status:'idle'} if never run; while running 'running'; once done 'done' (all verified)
Auth correctly enforced - both endpoints return 401 without Bearer token
POST /competitors/bulk-add correctly accepts and persists vision_* fields (vision_room_count, vision_price, vision_currency, vision_star_rating, vision_review_score, vision_review_count)
vision_checked_at is auto-set when vision_* fields are provided in bulk-add
GET /competitors returns competitors with vision_* fields populated after vision-enrich runs
Background task runs GPT-4o-mini Vision over Booking.com screenshots and extracts room_count, price, currency, star_rating, review_score, review_count
seed_data_creation: Created test competitor 'Vision Test Hotel {uuid}' with vision_* fields via bulk-add endpoint
context_for_next_testing_agent: Vision enrich endpoints fully tested. Key findings: (1) POST /competitors/vision-enrich correctly queues background task for properties with competitors and returns no_competitors for empty sets, (2) GET /competitors/vision-status correctly tracks progress with status, total, done, enriched, blocked, errors fields, (3) POST /competitors/bulk-add correctly accepts and persists vision_* fields, (4) Vision extraction via GPT-4o-mini is working - competitors show vision_room_count, vision_price, vision_currency, vision_is_blocked, vision_checked_at after enrichment, (5) Some competitors return null for room_count/price when Booking.com page doesn't show explicit room count or price is not visible in screenshot.
